# commit create --all exposes Git's prepared index to the fill command.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T20:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git add tracked.txt
git commit -m Initial
gs repo init
gs branch create feature --no-commit

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation
cp $WORK/update.txt tracked.txt

# A failed command leaves the original index unchanged.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8
! gs commit create --all --fill
stderr 'status 8'
git diff --cached --quiet

# Invoke from a subdirectory and let post-commit inspect the installed index.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=
exec mock-message-hook install
mkdir sub
cd sub
gs commit create --all --fill
stderr 'post-commit saw the installed index'
cmp $WORK/invocation/staged $WORK/golden/staged.txt
cmp $WORK/invocation/unstaged $WORK/golden/empty.txt

git show HEAD:tracked.txt
cmp stdout $WORK/update.txt

-- repo/tracked.txt --
original
-- update.txt --
updated
-- message.txt --
Tracked edit
-- golden/staged.txt --
tracked.txt
-- golden/empty.txt --
